name: WhatsApp Business
desc: Send text, media and template messages from your WhatsApp Business number.

actions.name: sendMessage
actions.description: Send a text message through WhatsApp

actions.name: sendMedia
actions.description: Send an image, video, audio, document or sticker by URL.

actions.name: send-template-message
actions.description: Send an approved template, filling in its placeholders.

actions.name: send_interactive_buttons
actions.description: Sends a message with up to three quick-reply buttons.

actions.name: send_interactive_list
actions.description: Sends a message that opens a menu of up to ten selectable rows.

actions.name: send_interactive_cta_url
actions.description: Sends a message with a single button that opens a web link.

actions.name: send_location
actions.description: Sends a map pin for a latitude and longitude.

actions.name: send_contact
actions.description: Sends a contact card the recipient can save.

actions.name: send_reaction
actions.description: Reacts to a message with an emoji, or removes an existing reaction.

actions.name: mark_message_as_read
actions.description: Shows the sender blue ticks for a received message, optionally with a typing indicator.

actions.name: upload_media
actions.description: Uploads a file to WhatsApp and returns a media ID you can send.

actions.name: get_media_url
actions.description: Looks up a media ID and returns its download URL and metadata.

actions.name: download_media
actions.description: Downloads a received media file so later steps can use it.

actions.name: delete_media
actions.description: Deletes an uploaded media file from WhatsApp.

actions.name: list_message_templates
actions.description: Lists the message templates on the business account, optionally filtered by status.

actions.name: create_message_template
actions.description: Submits a new message template for Meta review.

actions.name: edit_message_template
actions.description: Replaces the components of an existing template and resubmits it for review.

actions.name: delete_message_template
actions.description: Deletes a message template from the business account.

actions.name: list_phone_numbers
actions.description: Lists the phone numbers registered on the business account.

actions.name: get_phone_number
actions.description: Returns the details and health of one business phone number.

actions.name: get_business_profile
actions.description: Returns the public business profile shown for a phone number.

actions.name: update_business_profile
actions.description: Updates the public business profile for a phone number. Empty fields are left unchanged.

triggers.name: new_incoming_message
triggers.description: Fires when a customer sends your business number a message.

triggers.name: new_message_reaction
triggers.description: Fires when a customer reacts to one of your messages with an emoji, or removes a reaction.

triggers.name: message_status_updated
triggers.description: Fires when a message you sent is delivered, read, or fails.

triggers.name: template_status_updated
triggers.description: Fires when Meta approves, rejects, pauses or otherwise changes a message template.
